scope: One real application preparation using verified source inputs, two worker-authored JSON artifacts and independently reviewed controller-rendered documents.

worker.tools: Native file tools plus the existing strict JSON static validator; no worker shell or browser tool.
worker.validation_requirement: A successful native validator result must bind each final JSON file and the unchanged validator by hash, after its last edit.
worker.static_validation_limit: Syntax validation does not establish factual support, fit, style or PDF layout.
worker.permissions_limit: Native host permissions are not a newly qualified operating-system sandbox.
worker.effort_configuration_evidence: Both recorded native CLI invocations explicitly used --effort xhigh; internal model effort is not independently measured.

failure_categories: application-control block on a rendering dependency

alternate_transport.method: Controller uses the unchanged canonical HTML/layout logic and recorded PDF options through a Node/Playwright transport to installed Edge.
alternate_transport.input_mode: saved local text and JSON only
alternate_transport.execution_context: Approved controller host invocation; fresh headless browser with Chromium sandbox enabled, offline context and no logged-in user profile.
alternate_transport.limits: A transport qualification does not pass the original full Python preflight, certify actual candidate content/layout, establish identical rasterization across engines or qualify arbitrary candidate execution.

acceptance.source_grounding_review: passed after one evidence classification correction
acceptance.letter_pdf_readback: complete after one explicitly documented extraction linebreak join
acceptance.advert_pdf_readback: complete saved employer body and metadata
acceptance.limits: Native completion, selected check results and transport readiness are separate from complete preparation acceptance.
acceptance.counting_note: No aggregate test-count claim: content, syntax, hash, readback and visual checks are different checks on one task, not independent samples.

accounting.note: One controller-to-worker repair request corrected two defects; four native Edit calls are not four human corrections. Native usage includes the rejected build and repair. Preparation, orchestration, evaluation, cash billing, active human time and user resolution are unmeasured; reused qualification is not charged again.

application_outcomes.note: A usable preparation does not establish login readiness, absence of an earlier submission, form completion or a new submission.

investor_questions.exact_claim: On this one real preparation, can a bounded worker deliver grounded application data and honest fit notes that survive independent finished-document checks? Yes, after one repair.
investor_questions.compared_with: A capable coding/writing agent with the same verified sources, approved templates and working rendering/check tools is a competent alternative. No comparison arm is run here.
investor_questions.stop_condition: One build and at most one repair under the recorded limits. Unsupported factual claims or failed final checks block acceptance; do not relax criteria to obtain a pass.
investor_questions.losses_and_regressions: Initial draft had a German case error and an overbroad supported-evidence label. Canonical Python preflight failed; controller used a reviewed local render transport, corrected an advert capture note and documented an extraction newline. Login still blocks form access. No comparison establishes a regression rate.
investor_questions.actual_cost: Native execution API-equivalent usage: $1.9586855, including both attempts; 336,367 tokens across all reported input/output/cache categories. Preparation, controller evaluation, cash billing and human time are unknown.
investor_questions.next_expenditure_decision: Use the accepted documents for the next authorized application step after sign-in and prior-submission reconciliation. For a later task, reuse the verified render path and check preparation time before deciding whether further infrastructure is worth funding.

limitations: This is one real task, not an estimate of success rates or a controlled orchestration comparison.
Preparation, runtime readiness, worker completion, artifact acceptance and application outcomes remain separate.
Existing source assertions are not independent employment verification; explicit later corrections govern conflicting older wording.
General candidate execution remains unqualified under MAQ-001.
P003 and P004 remain unchanged; P004's rejected normalizer is not installed or silently reused as an accepted capability.
No performance gain, full research cost or user-confirmed resolution is established. Private application evidence limits public independent reproduction.

controller_incidents.resolution: Exact one-location newline join backed by unchanged HTML and visual inspection; original mismatches retained.
